notes: In Andrew's IKEA cart (2026-10-26; the cart page showed two at 2:20 PM, and Andrew that evening: "there aren't 2 radmanso nightstands", so one), with the RÅDMANSÖ king ikea-69598638: shortlisted on that. Flags: none (22 7/8" tall, under F-21's 27"; no glass). Fit (master-bedroom): it cannot stand beside the king on either side. The window side has 20 7/8" between the heater's face and the RÅDMANSÖ king's frame, and this needs 27 1/4" there (its 21 1/4" front along the head wall plus F-33's 6" off the heater); turned, with its 15 1/8" along the wall, its drawer would open against the bed's side. The bathroom side is the door's 30" landing (F-31). So in a and h it stands beside the POÄNG reading chair on the left wall in place of the LACK side table (15 1/8" off the wall, 21 1/4" along it), its drawer and shelf for the chair. A drawer with a brass-look knob, an open shelf, cable management for a lamp or a phone charger, black metal legs with 12 5/8" under; contract grade; designer Francis Cayouette. One package 22 ½ x 14 ¾ x 4 ¾", 28 lb 6 oz. Out of stock at IKEA Long Island, NY and unavailable for click and collect; home delivery available (2026-10-26). 4.3 stars (109).
